activity_statements.statement: designs and sells high-performance athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for yoga, running, training, and other active pursuits through 800+ stores and e-commerce globally
operates 800+ company-owned retail stores across 24 market locations worldwide as the primary sales channel for premium athletic wear
builds community around fitness and wellness through in-store events, ambassador programs, and brand experiences to drive customer loyalty
employs 39,000 people across retail stores, distribution, corporate, and design functions
executes an international expansion strategy with priority markets in Asia and Europe to grow beyond the North American core

name_reality_gap: The 'Retail & Wholesale' label is accurate; what it hides is that lululemon is a premium brand built as much on community and culture as on fabric — and that its supply chain is entirely outsourced manufacturing, making design, brand, and retail the actual competencies.
extraction_notes: Main lululemon.com pages timed out. info.lululemon.com about page loaded and provided key facts. Limited financial detail beyond employee count (39K) and store count (800+).
